conflicts.where: Lesson 6 (How it explains the phenomenon) vs Lessons 1 and 4
conflicts.problem: Lesson 6 says that drawing 'five diagonals from one vertex' of the seven-sided plot gives five triangles. A heptagon has only four diagonals from one vertex, and these make 7 - 2 = 5 triangles. Lessons 1 and 4 describe the construction correctly, so the lessons contradict each other here.
